name: GIBS catalog host adapter
description: Host side of the GIBS catalog retrieval flow: plugin.getConfig (keys gibs_catalog_enabled, gibs_catalog_producer_peer_id, gibs_catalog_source), the retrieval receipt, and adding the merged catalog file to the node's IPFS through the existing ipfs capability (ipfs.add, pinned). Parsing, merging and the $PNM record stay in the portable core.

sequentialJustification.detail: One configuration read or one ipfs.add host call per file, serially; the host owns I/O. No threads.

wildcardJustification.detail: Generic timer tick. Configuration is supplied by plugin.getConfig.
